title: Dispensing optician identification tags.
bodyText: Each licensed dispensing optician may wear an identification tag for the purpose of identifying to the customer that the person is a licensed dispensing optician.
bodyHtml: [§458-6.9]  Dispensing optician identification tags.  Each licensed dispensing optician may wear an identification tag for the purpose of identifying to the customer that the person is a licensed dispensing optician. [L 1997, c 301, §1]
